title: Figures 1 and 2: geometry of slant and horizontal atmospheric path lengths
description: Hand-drawn technical diagrams. Figure 1 is a triangle with sides labeled R, L and H and angles θ and φ at an observer point on a curved surface, illustrating the geometry of a slant path from the Earth's surface. Figure 2 shows the curved Earth with a hatched atmospheric layer and arrows for "Vertical path (No. 1)," "Horizontal path from surface" (No. 2), path No. 3, and a dashed path No. 4 at height H1.
